__description: Canonical compatibility projection for the active KBD waypoint. Writers emit camelCase only. Legacy snake_case aliases are accepted by migration readers but are never written.
__path_note: Canonical arbitrary-depth position chain. SELECTED-VS-ENTERED INVARIANT: when path[]'s trailing token equals childPointer the child is SELECTED (not entered) and /kbd-new-child adds a SIBLING; when childPointer is null/cleared the deepest path[] node is ENTERED and /kbd-new-child NESTS under it. Descent = set path[] + clear childPointer (/kbd-child-exit --enter). See SKILL.md 'Nested phases'.
